premises.text: Most site traffic is one-shot and forgettable while a tiny share of true fans drive disproportionate page views and deeper engagement; publishers waste spend chasing one-shot SEO traffic
premises.evidence_span: more than 84% of a site's traffic visits just once a month or less frequently

premises.text: One True Fan credits fan activity with good-natured gameplay, leaderboards, and presence of who else is on a page (including social-network friends and Twitter sharers)
premises.evidence_span: We give them credit, give players credit for their activities, and give them a bit of good natured gameplay

premises.text: Privacy controls over check-ins and no sharing of complete browsing history; users discover people who love the same content via profiles and shared articles
premises.evidence_span: You have complete control over where you check in, if you want to check in automatically on a site

premises.text: Helps sites identify and connect with most valuable users (including invisible non-commenters) with roadmap of stats, APIs, and tangible loyalty rewards—business model as web loyalty rewards program

value.text: Engage true fans rather than chasing disposable one-shot traffic
